resources.string: Your usual problems, one tap each
Stool, urine or vomit, one tap to note what it looked like
Note how you feel and message your family in one tap
MedLog SOS: start WhatsApp group call
Used only during an SOS you start. When MedLog opens your family SOS group in WhatsApp, this presses the call button for you. It reads nothing else and does nothing at any other time.
